cases.answer: Based on live track records from 2026-09-04 to 2026-11-07, the overall mean absolute error (MAE) is 7.745 against OpenAQ measurements, beating CAMS in 62 of 65 days with a skill score of 0.459. cases.question: Why does the model use CAMS as an input if CAMS is wrong?
cases.answer: Even though raw CAMS data can be inaccurate, the model uses it as a helpful signal and outperforms it by correcting its errors.
